retweet.text:
ELON MUSK ON BUILDING A “STAR MIND” POWERED BY THE SUN

“We’ve already built the most powerful AI training clusters in the world. And then what we expect to do by the end of next year is about 10 times more than what we’ve done thus far. This will be very important practice for space AI.

And I do think that AI training will continue to be on the ground, but AI inference, the day-to-day use of AI, will be in space. So we’re aiming to get to 10 gigawatts by the end of next year. This is depending on what the value per watt is.

If the value per watt is probably going to be $30 to $50, which means if we bring 10 gigawatts of AI online by the end of next year, it will be $300 to $500 billion a year in revenue. Big numbers. And sometimes I wonder, what is our purpose?

And it could be that the purpose of humanity is to give birth to a star mind, a sentient sun. I don’t know what the AI is going to think about, honestly. It’s a lot of compute.

But I guess this is the next step in the evolution of a civilization, is to harness the power of the sun. There was a physicist called Kardashev who argued that you could consider any given civilization on the basis of whether it has been able to harness most of the power of its planet, or most of the power of its sun, or most of the power of its galaxy, and beyond. So that’s what’s going to happen.

And we’re going to do it. The factory for star mind will be located nearby, adjacent to us, basically. They just come from space.”

quoted.text:
Grok Build has a really nice way to learn the entire tool without ever leaving the terminal

Just type /tour or /tutorial, and Grok Build walks you through everything step by step

It covers:
• Your first prompt
• Attaching files, images & screenshots
• Navigation
• Slash commands
• Parallel work with Worktrees
• Plan Mode & permissions
• AGENTS.md, memory & themes
• Guides, feedback & best practices

It even makes switching from Claude, Cursor, or Codex easier, with support for carrying over your settings, rules, and skills

Instead of opening a massive documentation page and trying to figure everything out yourself, you can learn Grok Build interactively while actually using it

If you're new to Grok Build, just start with /tour

SpaceX’s recent video volume was a little low, so I just gave it to Grok Build and asked it to increase the volume by +10 dB

Grok analyzed the audio, boosted it, added soft compression + limiting to keep everything under control, and gave me the finished video

Then after seeing the audio levels Grok gave me, I realized there was still room to push it another +10 dB

So I literally asked again

Grok Build boosted it to +20 dB total, re-encoded the video and handed me the final file

And it did the whole thing literally in just 25 seconds 😭

If I were doing this manually, I’d have to open editing software, understand gain, compression and limiting, adjust everything myself and export the video again

That could easily take me 10–20 minutes

With Grok Build, I just explained what I wanted in plain English and it handled everything for me
